title: tc-year-list
description:
Years to choose one from, newest first – a column, or a row that scrolls – with an optional count on each and
typing a year to jump to it.

label.description: What the years are for – the list's accessible name

years.description: The years, in the order shown; when empty, `to` down to `from`

from.description: The oldest year, when `years` isn't given

to.description: The newest year, when `years` isn't given

selected.description: The chosen year. Changed by the user unless a tc-selected-change listener calls preventDefault()

counts.description: A count to show beside each year, by year: { 2026: 1204 }

countLabel.description: What the counts are, said after each: "contributions"

orientation.description: A column ("vertical") or a row that scrolls ("horizontal")

locale.description: The language for counts, e.g. "de"; by default the browser's
